name: Red Nova Dragon - Burning Soul
text:
2 Tuners + 1 non-Tuner
Must be either Synchro Summoned, or Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing 2 Tuners and 1 "Red Dragon Archfiend" from your GY. Cannot be destroyed by card effects. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 card from your GY to your hand, and if you do, this card gains 2000 ATK. You can only use this effect of "Red Nova Dragon - Burning Soul" once per Duel, and only if you have Synchro Summoned "Red Dragon Archfiend".
